test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Discontent
solution:
The correct answer is Satisfaction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word 'discontent' is 'the state of being unhappy with something'.
 
• Let's consider each option-
 
 
• ​Serenity-The quality of being peaceful and calm.
 
• Satisfaction- **Fulfillment of one's wishes, expectations**, or needs, or **the pleasure** derived from this.
 
• Approval- Feeling, showing or saying that you think something is good; agreement.
 
• Relaxation: Something that you do in order to rest, especially after work or effort.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate antonym for the word 'discontent' is 'satisfaction'.
 
• Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.
